# What You Get

- 
Study Guide PDF (17 visual diagrams): Every concept from Anthropic's official certification exam guide broken down with full-page diagrams and plain English summaries. One concept per page. Print it, reference it, study it.

- 
Interactive Study Prompts (link included): Community-created domain-by-domain prompts. Paste them into Claude Code and it interviews you on each section, adapting to your level.

- 
Official Exam Guide Link: Direct link to Anthropic's 40-page certification document. Read it alongside this guide for full depth.
